user_query: I want to plan a family gathering with games, activities, and barbecue recipes, and check the weather forecast for tomorrow.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of fun outdoor games and activities suitable for a family gathering.
Gather detailed instructions on how to play each of the suggested outdoor games.
Find and recommend delicious barbecue recipes for the gathering.
Check the current weather forecast for tomorrow to ensure suitable conditions for the gathering.
